review.pendingReason: The September 29 repository audit repaired and refreshed source/notice evidence. Exact final desktop and engine artifacts, public matching-source delivery, guest-agent binary reproducibility and historical installer coverage still require release-specific verification.
review.scope: Historical staging source/notices and exact runtime reviewed on 2026-09-14. The current appliance and application changes are not yet approved for distribution.
decisions: Original Yougori code uses the owner's selected AGPL-3.0-only plus NOTICE, with a separate paid commercial option limited to rights Yougori LLC can grant. Third-party licenses remain valid. This license choice does not establish compatibility of an otherwise incompatible combination.
QEMU is built from the supplied pinned upstream source and GPL-compatible local modifications; the retired JACK/Berkeley DB import chain is absent.
QEMU exchanges TPM wire commands with a separate BSD helper; no QEMU internal objects or OpenSSL library are linked into QEMU through that helper.
GMP, Nettle and libunistring use their upstream GPL-2.0-or-later library option; original license declarations and full GPLv2 text are retained.

Package-built shared libraries have matching MSYS recipes/source inputs; ANGLE is rebuilt from the retained inputs using its separately reviewed D3D11-only profile. Recipients may rebuild/replace them and update editable integrity manifests.
Linux/appliance packages have exact aports recipes and checked distfiles. Firmware source revisions, build configuration and unchanged shipped bytes are recorded.
Static OCI libraries have corresponding Debian source/patches and application sources/build procedures for relinking; the musl-linked local helper rebuilt byte-for-byte.
NoVNC and other copyleft source materials and third-party attribution are retained independently of Yougori's root license.

Copied Coss UI components and the shared class-name helper retain MIT, with explicit file mapping, upstream attribution and pinned MIT declarations. Current original Yougori modifications are offered under AGPL-3.0-only.
Tailwind 4.3.3 is included in shipped dependency notices despite its npm development flag because its generated CSS and Preflight form part of the application.

QEMU modification notices cover all ten changed upstream files. Applying the supplemental comment patch preserves all twelve original build-source hashes after removing only the new headers; existing build records are retained.
Frontend source/assets, copied-code notices and production CSS/module imports are checked. Source index/checksum mismatches and publication evidence for an older index are rejected.
The recorded runtime tests passed. Exported QEMU source restoration, patch equivalence and configure/dependency-graph checks passed.
Public source access must be verified before distribution. Old installer source gaps remain separate and have not been declared resolved.

The two ANGLE DLL implementations were rebuilt from revision 890b5d8fa2988e3719e0d80421bf3e927db9cd5c. Their 33 reachable targets and 1,633 compiler/source inputs exclude Vulkan/SPIRV-Tools/Vulkan Loader/VMA/SwiftShader code; preprocessing confirms that Apache Roboto glyph data is absent.

ANGLE embedded notices explicitly retain Chromium helpers, xxHash, Khronos interfaces, Bison/Flex output permissions and compiler support terms. The historical AMD VMA MIT notice is also retained for the replaced MSYS2 package.

Six Khronos Apache headers contain only API declarations/constants/platform types, with no executable implementation; Apache section 1 excludes mere interface binding from its derivative-work definition. Their source headers and Apache text remain available. This narrow review does not extend to Apache implementation-bearing libraries.

GCC Runtime Library Exception, LLVM exception and Bison output exception apply to the recorded compilation/output; full terms and supplementary MinGW/Boost/zlib notices are retained. The build uses the unmodified standard GCC toolchain.

All 77 Windows PE identities/imports are explicitly pinned for native license review. The checker includes libepoxy -> EGL bridge -> ANGLE EGL -> GLES dynamic loads, exact ANGLE build identity, per-component decisions and full embedded notices.

Eight diskless GPU initialization/selection checks passed for ordinary and secure QEMU. Alpine and Ubuntu non-root hardware rendering tests passed, including physical-adapter switching. The excluded native implementation literal matches fell to zero for SPIRV-Tools, Vulkan Loader and VMA.

Twenty JavaScript compliance regressions and thirteen Python collector/native-source regressions passed; source/archive, full payload and staging CI results are recorded with the remediation evidence.

The AGPL/commercial change affects licensing text, package metadata and corresponding-source records. Native executable and DLL bytes are unchanged; paid terms cannot remove third-party GPL/LGPL/MPL obligations. A commercial license requires a separate written agreement and sufficient ownership/contributor rights.

Application source delivery now includes the tracked frontend, Rust backend, CLI, manifests/lockfiles, assets and scripts in a separate indexed application archive. The packaging gate verifies the current file manifest and actual archive entries, including omissions after archive rehashing. This extends the prior checker coverage; zero recorded blockers is not a blanket legal certification.

The unresolved September 10 installer download links were removed from staging README. COPYING is the installer license display file, and an extracted/installed-resource checker compares notices with the reviewed checkout. Actual new installer inspection is deferred until those installers are built; historical source gaps remain unresolved.

currentAudit.basis: All initial 1377 tracked paths inventoried; notices and source archives refreshed; native evidence rechecked. This does not approve any final installer or waive third-party obligations.

historicalReleaseIssues.reason: Older installer payloads, including the retired stock QEMU build, need their own source records. This new runtime does not retroactively establish their coverage. See compliance/history.
